PROGRAM BACKGROUND The program seeks to recapitalize the existing oceanographic survey ship fleet. This fleet provides marine and hydrographic data collection to support preparation of maps, charts, books, geodetic products, and numerical and oceanographic prediction The Department of the Navy’s (DON) current oceanographic survey ship capabilities are provided by six PATHFINDER (T-AGS 60) Class ships.
